headline: Nasdaq drops 2.9% as rate hike fears and weak China PMI weigh on markets
summary: The Nasdaq fell 2.9% amid growing expectations of a December Federal Reserve interest rate hike, alongside a technology stock selloff, weak Chinese purchasing managers' index data, and higher oil prices.
why: The Federal Reserve is the central bank of the United States, whose monetary policy decisions influence global financial markets and asset valuations.
why_moved: Market expectations shifted toward a Federal Reserve rate hike in December amid a tech selloff, weak China PMI data, and rising crude prices.
